q_45367.question_text: What will be NVIDIA's forward guidance in its Q2 FY2027 earnings release? (Revenue)
q_45367.reasoning:
# Analysis of NVIDIA Q2 FY2027 Forward Guidance

## (a) Time left until resolution
Today is August 16, 2026. Q2 FY2027 results are scheduled to be announced on August 26, 2026. This leaves **10 days** until the guidance is revealed.

## (b) Most likely outcome and why

NVIDIA has already announced forward guidance for Q2 FY2027. According to the CURRENT RESEARCH provided, **NVIDIA announced an outlook of $91.0 billion ± 2%** when reporting Q1 FY2027 results on May 20, 2026.

This means:
- **Central guidance: $91.0 billion**
- Range: $89.18 billion to $92.82 billion (accounting for the ±2% guidance range)

The guidance was already made public 3 months before the actual earnings release, which is standard practice for semiconductor companies. Since the question asks "What will be NVIDIA's forward guidance in its Q2 FY2027 earnings release," and that guidance has already been provided, the answer is simply the previously announced figure.

## (c) What would push the value lower?

- If NVIDIA were to revise guidance downward at the actual earnings release (highly unusual without a material negative event)
- If there were misinterpretation of the ±2% range to include only the lower bound

## (d) What would push the value higher?

- If NVIDIA were to revise guidance upward at the earnings release (possible but less common than guidance being met or slightly beaten)
- If there were misinterpretation of the ±2% range to include only the upper bound

## (e) Base rate or historical reference values

The provided research states directly: "On May 20, 2026... NVIDIA announced an outlook for Q2 FY2027 revenue to be **$91.0 billion, plus or minus 2%**" from official investor relations sources (investor.nvidia.com and SEC filings).

The guidance range provided in the question ($99.5B to $115.5B) is extremely wide and encompasses the known guidance with substantial buffer on both sides.

---

## Reasoning

Since NVIDIA has **already provided** the forward guidance on May 20, 2026 (before August 26 earnings), the most likely outcome is that they will reaffirm this guidance or provide an updated guidance at earnings. The central guidance of $91.0 billion is nearly certain, with the ±2% range ($89.18B - $92.82B) being the expected bounds.

The midpoint of $91.0 billion falls well below the midpoint of the provided range ($107.5B), suggesting the question's range may be accommodating uncertainty about whether guidance gets revised materially. However, the publicly announced guidance from May is the baseline expectation.

Given that guidance is typically sticky unless there's a major business development, and we're only 10 days from the earnings announcement, I expect NVIDIA to either reaffirm the $91.0 billion guidance or provide a narrowly adjusted figure.

**90th percentile (upper bound):** 92.82 billion (upper end of disclosed ±2% guidance range)

q_45367.research_text:
NVIDIA has already provided forward guidance for its Q2 FY2027 revenue. On May 20, 2026, when reporting Q1 FY2027 results, NVIDIA announced an outlook for Q2 FY2027 revenue to be $91.0 billion, plus or minus 2% [investor.nvidia.com](https://investor.nvidia.com/news/press-release-details/2026/NVIDIA-Announces-Financial-Results-for-First-Quarter-Fiscal-2027/), [sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1045810/000104581026000051/q1fy27pr.htm). This guidance excludes any Data Center compute revenue from China [investor.nvidia.com](https://investor.nvidia.com/news/press-release-details/2026/NVIDIA-Announces-Financial-Results-for-First-Quarter-Fiscal-2027/), [cnbc.com](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/05/20/nvidia-nvda-earnings-report-q1-2027.html), [sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1045810/000104581026000051/q1fy27pr.htm). Analysts' average quarterly revenue estimate for Q2 FY2027 was $86.84 billion, which NVIDIA's guidance surpassed [cnbc.com](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/05/20/nvidia-nvda-earnings-report-q1-2027.html).

NVIDIA's Q2 FY2027 financial results, covering the quarter ended July 26, 2026, are scheduled to be announced on Wednesday, August 26, 2026 [nvidianews.nvidia.com](https://nvidianews.nvidia.com/news/nvidia-sets-conference-call-for-second-quarter-financial-results-6927195).
